posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal have welcomed a baby boy, sharing heartfelt pregnancy updates and romantic Rajasthan vacation photos with fans on Instagram.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit made history as the first South Asian artist to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden during his AURA tour. His upcoming film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman is generating massive buzz.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia is gearing up for spy thriller 'Alpha' alongside Sharvari, with Cannes Film Festival appearances and industry debates keeping her in the spotlight.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is enjoying family time with daughter Malti and Nick Jonas while speculation about a Bollywood comeback with Sanjay Leela Bhansali continues to swirl.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is filming 'King' in South Africa with daughter Suhana Khan, confirmed for a Christmas 2026 release. He missed most of IPL 2026 as KKR was eliminated from playoffs.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is set to reunite with Salman Khan in a superhero film directed by Raj & DK, their first collaboration in over a decade. Filming begins October 2026.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha signed a massive ₹17 crore deal for a female-led thriller with Ekta Kapoor, following the blockbuster success of Stree 2. Stree 3 is also confirmed.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh and is using a body double for action sequences in SRK's 'King' and Atlee's 'Raka'.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer faces a FWICE ban over his abrupt exit from Don 3, with ₹45 crore in damages sought. He visited Chamundeshwari Temple in Mysuru after a Karnataka HC directive.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 with a dramatic white pantsuit and feathered cape for her 24th appearance. Daughter Aaradhya beamed with pride as she signed autographs for fans.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika presented at the Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside Winston Duke, who called her 'incomparable.' Her film Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor releases June 19.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's comeback trailer for 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' dropped, showcasing her fierce avatar as a daughter-in-law with intense action sequences. Releasing June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's sci-fi film 'Raka' with director Atlee was officially announced with a massive ₹600 crore budget. Reports suggest a collaboration with Lokesh Kanagaraj is also in the works.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' hits theatres June 4 with record-breaking North American advance bookings crossing $393K. He apologized for hilariously calling Jasprit Bumrah a 'footballer.'

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR confirmed a massive four-film lineup: War 2 with Hrithik Roshan, Dragon with Prashanth Neel (late 2026), Devara 2, and a Nelson Dilipkumar project.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in the much-anticipated 'Peddi' releasing June 4. She also turned heads at the New Balance Grey Days 2026 celebration alongside cricketer Pat Cummins.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's film 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya crossed ₹18 crore worldwide in its opening days. Her fusion Bharatanatyam dance sequence went viral amid heated debate online.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara and Sidharth Malhotra announced their pregnancy, sharing their first Met Gala experience while expecting. Baby Saraayah's serene demeanor has charmed fans.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is set to make his directorial debut with Krrish 4, produced with Yash Raj Films. The superhero saga aims for a 2027 theatrical release with global-scale VFX.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' directed by father David Dhawan is set for June 12 release. Salman Khan hilariously roasted him for recreating 'Chunari Chunari.'

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya announced her 'All Hearts Tour' and 'Unstoppable Tour' with US dates including Newark and Boston in September 2026. Tickets are selling fast for the Prudential Center show.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is collaborating with Hans Zimmer on the epic ₹4,000 crore Ramayana soundtrack, calling it his most significant project. He also performed live in Bhopal for the Peddi promotion.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay turned 51 with birthday wishes from stars across industries. His final film 'Jana Nayagan' awaits release amid legal delays as he transitions to full-time politics.
